---
title: "Knowledge graph"
subtitle: "Each node is a statute. Each line is a documented relationship between two statutes."
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
short_of <- stats::setNames(statutes$short, statutes$id)
```

**How to use it.** Click a statute to highlight its neighbors. Double-click to open its wiki page. Hover over a line to read why the two statutes are linked. Drag to rearrange, scroll to zoom, and use the two menus to find a statute or to isolate a domain or a U.S. Code title, such as Title 10 or Title 50.

```{r}
#| results: asis
# legend built from the same vocabularies the graph uses
legend_item <- function(css, label) {
  paste0("<span class=\"legend-item\"><span class=\"", css, "\"></span>", label, "</span>")
}

cat(
  "<div class=\"graph-legend\">",
  "<div><strong>Domain</strong>",
  paste0(
    "<span class=\"legend-item\"><span class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:", domain_colors,
    "\"></span>", domain_labels, "</span>", collapse = " "
  ),
  "</div>",
  "<div><strong>Status</strong>",
  legend_item("shape shape-dot", "In force"),
  legend_item("shape shape-square", "Partly expired or lapsed"),
  legend_item("shape shape-triangle", "Repealed or superseded"),
  "</div>",
  "<div><strong>Relationship</strong>",
  paste0(
    "<span class=\"legend-item\"><span class=\"line\" style=\"border-color:", relation_colors,
    ";border-top-style:", ifelse(names(relation_colors) == "related", "dashed", "solid"),
    "\"></span>", relation_labels, "</span>", collapse = " "
  ),
  "</div>",
  "</div>",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# node size reflects how many connections a statute has
degree <- tibble::tibble(id = c(edges$from, edges$to)) |>
  dplyr::count(id, name = "value")

nodes <- statutes |>
  dplyr::left_join(degree, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    id,
    label = short,
    group = domain_label,
    # one comma-separated field so a single menu filters by domain or code title
    filter = purrr::map2_chr(domain, usc_titles, \(d, t) {
      paste(c(paste("Domain:", domain_short[[d]]), paste("Code: Title", t)), collapse = ",")
    }),
    value = dplyr::coalesce(value, 0L),
    color = unname(domain_colors[domain]),
    # shape encodes legal status
    shape = dplyr::case_when(
      status == "in-force" ~ "dot",
      status %in% c("partly-expired", "lapsed") ~ "square",
      .default = "triangleDown"
    ),
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", title, "</b><br>", year, " | ", status_label,
      "<br><i>Double-click to open the page</i>"
    ),
    url = paste0("statutes/", id, ".html")
  )

vis_edges <- edges |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    from, to,
    # undirected for loose thematic links
    arrows = dplyr::if_else(relation == "related", "", "to"),
    dashes = relation == "related",
    color  = unname(relation_colors[relation]),
    title  = paste0(
      short_of[from], " <b>", relation_labels[relation], "</b> ", short_of[to], "<br>", note
    )
  )

# menu order: domains first, then code titles in numeric order
filter_values <- c(
  paste("Domain:", domain_short),
  paste("Code: Title", sort(unique(unlist(statutes$usc_titles))))
)

# the two menus are positioned over the canvas in styles.scss
menu_style <- "width: 46%; max-width: 260px; height: 32px;"

visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, vis_edges, width = "100%", height = "780px") |>
  visNetwork::visNodes(
    font = list(size = 22, color = "#1b2a41", strokeWidth = 4, strokeColor = "#ffffff"),
    # better-connected statutes get larger nodes and labels
    scaling = list(min = 12, max = 40, label = list(enabled = TRUE, min = 20, max = 32)),
    borderWidth = 1
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visEdges(width = 1.6, smooth = list(type = "continuous")) |>
  visNetwork::visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1),
    nodesIdSelection = list(enabled = TRUE, main = "Find a statute", style = menu_style),
    selectedBy = list(
      variable = "filter", multiple = TRUE, values = filter_values,
      main = "Filter by domain or code title", style = menu_style
    )
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(gravitationalConstant = -110, springLength = 150),
    stabilization = list(iterations = 400)
  ) |>
  # fixed seed so the layout is the same on every load
  visNetwork::visLayout(randomSeed = 1947) |>
  visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE, tooltipDelay = 120) |>
  visNetwork::visEvents(
    doubleClick = "function(p) {
      if (p.nodes.length) {
        window.location.href = this.body.data.nodes.get(p.nodes[0]).url;
      }
    }"
  )
```

## Every connection

The same relationships as a searchable table. Each row reads left to right.

```{r}
page_link <- function(id) {
  paste0("<a href=\"statutes/", id, ".html\">", short_of[id], "</a>")
}

edges |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    From = page_link(from),
    Relationship = unname(relation_labels[relation]),
    To = page_link(to),
    Note = note
  ) |>
  DT::datatable(
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 15, autoWidth = FALSE)
  )
```
